result.title: Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions
result.summary: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-δ$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $γ$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Selected-Risk Calibration（SRC）框架，针对用代理约束求解时「代理可行但真实不可行」的问题，以优化器返回决策为对象校准学习约束，并给出留出目标上不可行概率不超过 γ 的概率保证；同时说明 split conformal 的随机输入覆盖与反馈协变量偏移的似然比重加权都无法约束该风险。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以返回决策为条件的风险校准」与覆盖度失效分析，可能为 LVR 中停止决策、候选 latent 筛选及视觉证据验证的可信度校准提供概念线索，但是否可迁移到多模态推理状态尚需核查。
